title: THE ENAGETI INCIDENT
description: A village guardian is found dead at dawn.
incidentReport: Ginger was found beneath the Garden shortly after sunrise. The murder weapon was left at the scene. Marki, Bego, and Baxi were the only animals seen outside that morning.

interviews.speaker: Marki
interviews.statement: I never went anywhere near the Warehouse.

interviews.speaker: Bego
interviews.statement: The Crowbar was lying beside the Garden.

interviews.speaker: Baxi
interviews.statement: Everyone blames the old dog first. Believe what you want—I never carried the Rock.

clues: Bego was seen near the House.
The Crowbar was not taken to the Warehouse.
Baxi was not in the Garden.
